source_snapshot.test_name_items: Check ACPI replaced all Wistron string with Cisco string
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Boot into UEFI shell.
2. Command: ACPIVIEW > File.log

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. Check there is no Wistron string in the log.

original_test_intent: Verify from a complete UEFI ACPI dump that prohibited Wistron strings are absent and intended Cisco strings appear in the correct table/header/AML contexts.
original_method: An operator runs platform-compatible ACPIVIEW in UEFI Shell and preserves a complete File.log; the returned artifact is then scanned per table under owner-provided prohibited/expected mappings and encoding policy.
manual_activity: The source requires operator-run pre-OS ACPIVIEW and complete log capture; automated scanning can only analyze the supplied artifact.
required_inputs: Prohibited Wistron variants and expected Cisco strings per ACPI table
Complete unfiltered log and console evidence
safety_requirements: Use ACPIVIEW read-only; do not edit ACPI/AML, firmware or BIOS settings.
Hash and preserve the full table dump before scanning.
Do not prove replacement from absence of one literal or an OS-decoded subset.
Stop on truncated tables, encoding ambiguity or wrong tool/platform; no automatic rerun.
agent_execution_scope: Hash and perform table-aware scanning of the supplied full log, reporting every prohibited occurrence and each expected Cisco mapping with raw/decoded context.
Collect supporting OS ACPI/BMC health without claiming pre-OS execution or verdict.
engineer_actions: Run ACPIVIEW in UEFI Shell and preserve complete console/log evidence.
Approve table mappings/exceptions and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It correctly rejects SSH as a means to run the source UEFI tool; no OS substitute preserves identical coverage.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Execute the approved UEFI tool manually and automate only offline table-aware analysis of the unmodified artifact.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The ACPIVIEW redirection and 5/5-minute values remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Index complete raw/decoded ACPIVIEW output by table signature and location, then compare prohibited and expected brand strings under an explicit encoding/OEM policy.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact firmware/ACPI table set and branding policy.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC, UEFI Shell and ACPIVIEW versions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds table context, positive replacement validation and raw/AML handling.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects truncated or missing tables, encoded occurrences and correct/incorrect replacements in specific headers/objects.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Text rendering may not expose every AML binary sequence; ambiguous content needs raw table/RD analysis.

project_override_considerations: Projects may define allowed OEM strings and expected Cisco identities, but must retain table context and cannot claim full replacement from a global negative search alone.
expected_evidence: Platform/tool identity and table mapping policy
Complete original ACPIVIEW log with hash/size
Table-by-table prohibited and expected string results
AML/OEM exception decisions and health logs

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The positive title is broader than the negative criterion, but an owner-supplied Cisco table mapping closes the acceptance gap without changing source semantics.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The pre-OS procedure is clear; manual source execution makes it MANUAL ONLY rather than blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps the correct manual boundary and adds table-aware completeness.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains complete-log, mapping and AML/encoding safeguards.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates automated artifact analysis from operator execution and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents a clean global grep on an incomplete or decoded subset from passing a firmware whose intended Cisco table identities are absent.
independent_technical_reasoning: ACPI brand identity is distributed across structured table headers and AML/binary content; proof requires complete table provenance and context-specific source-to-target mapping, not a single literal search.
